card: Removes the configure-time introspection check for SetThreadDescription and assumes it is available on Windows, documents Mingw-w64 12.0 as the minimum required version, and drops MSVCRT support from the Nix cross-shell. Following the 33.x release branch, master now requires Mingw-w64 >= 12.0, making the compatibility probe introduced in #36057 unnecessary. It is an internal build configuration cleanup and documentation update for Windows cross-compilation.
evidence: PR description: 'A follow-up reverting #36057, now that we\'ve branched off for 33.x. Also documents mingw-w64 requirements (#32380).'
CMake comment removed in diff: 'Check for SetThreadDescription(), which is missing from mingw-w64 headers before 12.0.0.'
problem: A temporary configure check for SetThreadDescription was added in #36057 to support older Mingw-w64 toolchains prior to branching release 33.x. Now that master requires Mingw-w64 12.0 or newer, the fallback check is obsolete, the toolchain minimum was undocumented in the build guide, and legacy MSVCRT cross-compilation remained in developer Nix scripts.
summary: Removes the CMake configure-time check for SetThreadDescription in Windows builds and unconditionally calls the function on WIN32 platforms. Additionally, documents a minimum requirement of Mingw-w64 12.0 in the Windows build documentation and drops legacy MSVCRT support from the Nix cross-compilation shell.
